meta.title: Force start evaluation with Start Evaluation

args.goal: On the current prospect's Vendor Profile > Onboarding Details, click Start Evaluation and stop when the evaluation stage is shown with Approve and Reject available

steps.note: Performs the onboarding-specific action and verifies the resulting screen in the current buyer session.
Confirms the evaluation stage exposes the Approve action.
Confirms the evaluation stage exposes the Reject action.
